cues: A hub dynamo converts wheel motion into electricity, powering lights without frequent battery replacement.
Wearing a properly fitted helmet can reduce head injury severity if a rider falls or collides.
Replacing short car journeys with human-powered travel reduces fuel consumption and tailpipe pollution.
Hand-cranked adaptations let some riders propel themselves when leg movement is limited.
Linked cranks let two companions contribute force together, sharing the work of a longer outing.
Regular pedal-powered journeys provide low-impact cardiovascular exercise while accomplishing ordinary errands.
